title: ArtSnacks Alternatives: 5 Boxes Like ArtSnacks - Cratejoy
summary: Compare five art supply boxes like ArtSnacks, from monthly surprise supplies and a use-only-the-box challenge to watercolor and drawing lessons.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which alternative is closest to ArtSnacks?


SketchBox is the closest: a monthly box of full-size art supplies chosen around a theme, with instructions and a how-to video. If the #ArtSnacksChallenge was your favorite part, ScrawlrBox sets the same use-only-the-box rule each month and ships from the UK.


Which box is closest to WatercolorSnacks?


Nature Sketch Crate is the closest watercolor pick: a monthly watercolor and ink lesson with professional paint and paper, shipped to the US and Canada. It’s written for beginners, so an experienced painter may get more from SketchBox, whose monthly themes include watercolor and ink.


Is there a box like ArtJournalSnacks?


None of these five sends a journal and ephemera each quarter like ArtJournalSnacks. For mixed-media supplies to use in a journal of your own, SketchBox runs mixed-media themes, such as its September 2026 Vintage Mixed Media Premium Box.
